name: je-cross-border-withholding
description: Jersey cross-border individual tax and collection rules for 2026, covering residence, non-resident income exemptions, landlord deductions and treaty relief checks. Use for Jersey non-resident withholding, foreign income, short-term business visitors, rental agents or double taxation relief. Identifies payment categories and statutory conditions before any rate is applied, and distinguishes collection from final liability. Includes a bounded rental-agent deduction example. Treaty-specific benefits, corporate transfer pricing and complete relief calculations require further primary evidence. This source-cited draft awaits professional review and does not support a blanket statement that Jersey has no withholding or taxes no foreign income.
